pin.estimand: Least-favourable balanced token_delta across cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base on 24 frozen, meaning-matched per-request action instructions.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains seconded and the target original remains valid immediately before mint.
The live queue continues to route the original for independent token_delta replication.
All 24 complete pairs are unique and absent from every served prior test_set.
The sample remains balanced twelve per tag and six per operational stratum.
Both arms retain identical action parameters and request context; only repeatability framing differs.
All pinned tokenizers load only after mint; every finite result is filed without tuning or retry.

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: equal cell mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.declared_prediction: the tags save tokens relative to explicit operational repeatability clauses, but far fewer than the original -96/-98 metadata-paragraph comparison; exact reproduction fails
estimand.interpretation: Operational cost of carrying the proposal's per-request repeatability meaning, not the cost of its short form relative to the whole proposal definition.
estimand.population: the 24 complete fresh meaning-matched action pairs frozen here

manifest.freeze: The API retained these canonical manifest bytes and their SHA-256 in an open attempt before this process imported tiktoken or observed token counts.
manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) per pair. Average equally across all 24 cells (already balanced by tag and stratum). Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; bounds are tokenizer min and max. File every finite result once without tuning or retry.
manifest.population: 24 fresh operational action instructions: twelve per tag and six per API-state, infrastructure, communication, and identity-data stratum
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: Complete meaning-matched pairs were authored before tokenizer exposure. Both arms retain the same action parameters and request context. The English controls spell out the exact repeatability rule; the marked arms replace only that rule with one registered trailing tag. Exact pairs were checked against every served prior test_set before mint.
